tool_calls.scope: Request-local accumulation and final JSON argument parsing, excluding model inference and SSE transport
caveats: Allocation figures are cumulative temporary bytes, not peak RAM or VRAM.
No inference token/s, weights, quantization, context, model settings or quality change is claimed.
Wall time can vary with concurrent system load; cumulative allocation reductions are deterministic.
implementation: strings.Builder replaces quadratic per-fragment string concatenation for IDs, function names and arguments.
Finalization sorts received indices instead of scanning every missing integer through the maximum wire index.
Negative wire indices fail explicitly; sparse MaxInt indices terminate correctly.
Builders remain owned by one request and are never copied after use.

transfer_microbenchmark.scope: Transfer and fence stage; excludes helper construction. 3 warmups + 16 measured pairs with alternating order. Pinned host storage is benchmark-only, not enabled for production snapshots.

readiness_microbenchmark.scope: Synthetic CPU readiness checks, not inference or SSD throughput. 100000 repetitions, median of 7 alternating-order samples, 32 pages per task.

limitations: Cold means a new runner, not cold SSD/OS page caches.
Short local sequential samples are not a statistical proof of universal speedup or zero regression.
Physical managed allocator counters are not global RAM/VRAM caps.
Logical context stays131072; prompts here do not fill that capacity.
Transfer and string-assembly speedups are not model token/s gains.
Windows/CUDA runtime tested; Linux queue ordering only covered by synthetic CPU tests.
